news_analysis.headline_hook: Google Review scam: Over 20 people reportedly lose ₹1 crore in a month
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Reports show over 20 people lost a combined total of ₹1 crore within a month to a Google Review rating scam. The report highlights 5 critical warning signs for retail internet users to watch out for.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail individuals often assume small online rating tasks and pay-per-review offers are legitimate, low-risk income opportunities.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Scammers exploit trusted platform names like Google Reviews as bait, using initial micro-payouts to gain trust before tricking victims into depositing larger sums that cannot be withdrawn.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Verify any job offer requiring upfront deposits or fee payments, and never transfer money to secure promised payouts for online reviews.

deck.caption: Oru month-la ₹1 crore loss-aa? Online-la simple-ah Google reviews kuduthu easy-ah earn pannalam-nu ninaikira ellarukkum ithu oru periya warning! Initial-ah konjam paisa kuduthu trust build pannittu, apparam periya amount-ah 'task' periya level-la potta escape aagidranga scammers. Ungaluku ithu madhiri work-from-home offers vanthurukka? Unga experience enna? #GoogleReviewScam #CyberSecurityTamil #OnlineFraudAlert #RetailInvestors #SafeInvesting

flowchart_data.text: Scammers target pannuradhu trusted brands-oda Google ratings and reviews-ah.
Telegram or WhatsApp-la 'part-time job, daily payout' nu messages varum.
Initial-ah 10 or 20 reviews-ku real-ah konjam money unga account-ku send pannuvanga.

slides.title: Trust Building Phase
slides.card_text: First few times paisa correct-ah account-ku vandathum, namakku oru fake confidence vanthidum. 'Oho, ithu real-ana job thaan' nu nambi, avanga kekra periya investments-ku green signal koduthuruvom. Ithuthaan avangaloda main trap!

slides.title: The Pre-Payment Trap
slides.card_text: Konjam days poanathum, avanga 'Pre-paid tasks' or 'VIP membership' nu solli periya amount deposit panna solluvanga. 'Intha amount-ah transfer pannina ungalukku double payout varum' nu solli ஏமாத்துவாங்க.

slides.title: The Dead End
slides.card_text: Neenga periya amount transfer pannita, appuram twist start aagum. Website-la ungaloda earnings high-ah kaattum, aana withdraw panna mudiyaathu. 'Tax kattanum', 'Fee kattanum' nu solli innum konjam paisa kekkura varaikkum kettu vachu maattuvaanga.

checklist_data.text: Job offer requiring advance payment or deposit to unlock tasks.
Guaranteed high returns for zero genuine skill work.
Payouts routed through random personal UPI IDs or crypto wallets.

slides.title: Golden Rule to Stay Safe
slides.card_text: Evlo thaan financial pressure irunthalum, entha oru job-kum upfront money pay pannathinga. Entha platform-um job thara ungalta advance kekkaathu. Be smart, stay away from too-good-to-be-true online offers!

slides.title: Protect Your Hard-Earned Money
slides.cta_detail: Online-la varra random part-time job offers-ku advance paisa katrathukku munnala intha 5 warning signs-ah marakkama cross-check pannunga. Share this with your friends and family to save them from this scam!
